approval.statement: User explicitly directed the Graph Harness SHIP lifecycle to continue product completion beyond a single feature and requested a full CampaignOS product suitable for demonstrations while preserving strict zero-cost and no-production constraints.
approval.scope: Internal Operations/War Room UI over existing APIs plus the minimum current-session Team self-coverage needed for a human Operations owner; tests and review evidence only; no autonomous execution, citizen contact, targeting, persuasion, publication, spending, production deployment, Firmes implementation or paid cloud resources.

critic_findings.finding: A human Operations decision must not rewrite its alternatives and select the replacement in the same request.
critic_findings.repair: Require an existing decision record, exact equality with its persisted option list and a selected value from that existing set.

critic_findings.finding: Operations requires a FILLED Team owner while the existing UI could only create VACANT functions, leaving a fresh UI journey unable to create a roadmap.
critic_findings.repair: Add bounded current-session self-coverage through the existing Team update contract with server-owned authenticated principal, exact grants, positive capacity and explicit onboarding confirmation; create no membership or permission.

critic_findings.finding: Existing roadmap mutation controls stayed visible after the current Strategy stopped being DECIDED_INTERNAL even though server routes rejected writes.
critic_findings.repair: Require the current Strategy/Team prerequisite for the editor and snapshot authoring while preserving the historical read projection.

critic_findings.finding: The War Room immutable-evidence eyebrow was hardcoded in English on the Spanish route.
critic_findings.repair: Move the boundary label into the bilingual Operations dictionary and verify i18n/chapter rendering.

critic_findings.finding: The live shell rethrew backend 409 CAMPAIGN_NOT_READY when the Operations roadmap prerequisites were incomplete, making the whole shell unavailable before the functional journey could start.
critic_findings.repair: Classify only 404 and 409 CAMPAIGN_NOT_READY as Operations NOT_STARTED, 503 as dependency unavailable, and keep unrelated 409 conflicts fail-closed; regression tests cover the mapping.

campaignos_ci.root_cause: Operations roadmap read returned 409 CAMPAIGN_NOT_READY before prerequisites; shell read model treated it as global failure.
